how_to_apply: This is a walk-in interview, not an online application process. Eligible candidates must:
Fill the application in the prescribed format (the official Application Form is part of the notification).
Report in person at the Conference Hall (PCT), College of Technology, GBPUAT, Pantnagar, on 14/08/2026 at 09:00 AM.
Carry the filled application along with original certificates and one set of self-attested photocopies.
Attend the subject presentation and interview on the same date.
Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC/EWS categories must attach a self-attested photocopy of a valid category certificate and domicile certificate along with the application.

content_sections.heading: GBPUAT Teaching Personnel Important Dates
content_sections.text: No separate application start or closing date is mentioned in the notification, since candidates report directly on the interview date with their application and documents. No separate intimation will be sent for the walk-in-interview.

content_sections.heading: GBPUAT Teaching Personnel Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The notification lists 52 posts across 11 departments/disciplines, with reservation as per Uttarakhand Government policy. The table below reproduces the department-wise category breakup exactly as printed in the notification. Some cells in the original table contain more than one value stacked together (for example, a department showing both a general-category number and a separate "UF" - Uttarakhand Female - entry in the same column); these have been carried over as printed. Because a few of these multi-value cells are not fully unambiguous in the scanned notice, candidates should cross-check the exact category-wise entitlement against the official notification before applying. Abbreviations used in the notification: OCU = Orphan Children of Uttarakhand; FF = Freedom Fighter; PH = Physical Handicapped; UF = Uttarakhand Female. The number of seats may increase or decrease at the time of interview, and the College reserves the right not to fill any post at its discretion, without assigning any reason. If no eligible candidate is available in a reserved category, the position will be filled from the unreserved/other category.

content_sections.text: B.E./B.Tech./B.S. and M.E./M.Tech./M.S. or Integrated M.Tech. in the relevant branch, with First Class or equivalent in any one of the degrees, as applicable for Assistant Professor qualification. Any one of the following: B.E./B.Tech./B.S. and M.E./M.Tech./M.S. or Integrated M.Tech. in the relevant branch, with First Class or equivalent in any one of the degrees. B.E./B.Tech. and MCA, with First Class or equivalent in any one of the two degrees. Graduation of three years' duration with Mathematics as a compulsory subject, and MCA with First Class or equivalent, along with 2 years of relevant experience after acquiring the MCA degree. The notification does not specify a separate age limit for these posts.

content_sections.heading: GBPUAT Teaching Personnel Salary / Emoluments 2026
content_sections.text: The total emoluments in a month shall not exceed: Rs. 30,000/- per month for candidates fulfilling the eligibility of Assistant Professor in the concerned discipline, at the rate of Rs. 650/- per hour, OR A maximum of Rs. 25,000/- per month for candidates possessing a B.Tech. degree with First Division in the concerned discipline, at the rate of Rs. 550/- per hour. No TA/DA (travel or dearness allowance) will be paid to candidates for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the GBPUAT College of Technology Teaching Personnel Walk-in Interview 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notice (No. CTE/469, dated 06/08/2026) from the College of Technology, GBPUAT, Pantnagar, to engage Teaching Personnel on a purely contractual basis for the I Semester 2026-27 through a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: 52 posts in total, spread across 11 departments/disciplines, including Civil Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Farm Machinery and Power Engineering, Industrial & Production Engineering, Information Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Post Harvest Process and Food Engineering, Soil and Water Conservation Engineering, and MCA (Self Finance).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: There is no separate last date; candidates must appear directly at the walk-in interview on 14/08/2026 at 09:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: For Engineering branch posts: B.E./B.Tech./B.S. and M.E./M.Tech./M.S. or Integrated M.Tech. in the relevant branch with First Class or equivalent in any one degree. For the MCA programme, alternate qualification routes are specified (see the Qualification section above).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply?
faq.answer: This is a walk-in interview. Candidates should bring the filled application form, original certificates, and one set of self-attested photocopies to the Conference Hall (PCT), College of Technology, GBPUAT, Pantnagar, on 14/08/2026 at 09:00 AM.
